source.read_scope: Every extracted line 1–5526 and every PDF page 552–690; sequential bounded reads with no truncation.
source.version_note: Text includes changes explicitly associated with Live 12.4 in Erosion; minimum builds for other revised devices are not inferred.
source.distribution: Private source extraction is not reproduced; runtime guidance is original paraphrase with exact UI names and necessary factual values.

coverage_summary.source_vs_synthesis: Device features, ranges, modes, timing distinctions, and examples are source-derived. Verification, permission boundaries, preservation cautions, matched-level comparisons, and recovery ordering are safety/verification synthesis.

non_operational_material.handling: Not reproduced as an instruction; edition-availability warning retained.
Credits omitted from operational guidance; relevant model behavior and Live 9 Compressor algorithm-change note retained.

synthesis_records.basis: Cross-device distinction between insert/return, detector and output mix, MIDI gating, latency, and meters.
Explicit feedback-level hazards, clipper limitations, and final-chain gain constraints.
Explicit buffer replacement/clear/halve behavior and modulation-matrix erase behavior; no destructive operation executed.
Check gating/routing/mode/disabled controls first using the described state dependencies before adding gain.
Hardware latency is not automatically known; measurement devices depend on input and analysis settings.

gaps_and_uncertainties.issue: The sidechain chooser enumeration includes band-pass but subsequent prose describes Notch instead of band-pass.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime retains the enumerated six choices, requires inspection of the actual chooser, and does not assert a Notch sidechain option.

gaps_and_uncertainties.issue: Free delay time is described as being set in Hertz, which conflicts with ordinary duration terminology; exact installed UI units were not observed.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime describes free versus beat-synced delay and requires reading the visible unit; it does not invent a millisecond conversion or automation parameter.

gaps_and_uncertainties.issue: Opening and Delay prose describe freezer feeding delay, while Global Controls explicitly provides Frz > Dly and Dly > Frz.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime uses the explicit order selectors and avoids asserting a universal fixed order.
gaps_and_uncertainties.status: reconciled from explicit control description; execution not verified

gaps_and_uncertainties.issue: X-Fade description mixes milliseconds with a percentage of Interval and does not fully explain the unit in Onsets mode.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime describes a relative-interval crossfade and asks for the displayed unit; no numeric crossfade prescription.

gaps_and_uncertainties.issue: The M/S description refers to material recorded using M/S encoding but does not spell out an encoding/decoding workflow.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime gives only M/S channel-selection/editing guidance, not a claim that pre-encoded input is required.
gaps_and_uncertainties.status: encoding workflow not established by assigned evidence

gaps_and_uncertainties.issue: Precise driver/hardware latency calibration is delegated to an external article, outside the assigned extracted chapter.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime includes routing, level checks, delay-compensation prerequisite, sample/ms persistence, and measured-transient verification; does not fabricate a calibration value or detailed interface-specific procedure.
gaps_and_uncertainties.status: dependency not retrieved; setup-dependent measurement remains

gaps_and_uncertainties.issue: General edition variation, Vocoder exclusion from Intro/Lite, and Erosion Legacy for pre-12.4 Sets are explicit; full per-device edition/minimum-build matrix is not supplied.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime validates installed device/version/license and makes no additional entitlement promises.

gaps_and_uncertainties.issue: Extracted text was read in full; rendered diagrams/screenshots were not inspected.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: No pixel coordinates or unlabeled diagram geometry is invented. Looper gesture-state transitions and other necessary relationships are recoverable from adjacent prose. No essential text-unrecoverable diagram identified.

gaps_and_uncertainties.issue: Device UI features do not establish integration support or parameter identifiers.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: Runtime clearly labels UI guidance; no extension/API capability mapping is added. That mapping is parent-owned.

gaps_and_uncertainties.issue: No Live session, audio audition, device loading, MIDI/hardware route, performance benchmark, or behavioral evaluation was executed.
gaps_and_uncertainties.handling: All sound-character and control-behavior claims remain source-derived, never experiment-backed.
